name: tranfr
description: Programmable recovery for CKB self-custody — a lock script that lets an owner keep full control of their assets while active, and lets a designated recovery recipient claim them if the owner goes inactive for a defined period. No custodian, no oracle, no protocol changes.

scripts.test:all: cargo test && tsx --test reference/since-cmp-ts/since_cmp.test.ts && tsx --test sdk/tests/*.test.ts
